name: NKD Long Sleeve Top - Cold Foam
title: NKD Long Sleeve Top - Cold Foam
typePath: NKD Long Sleeve Top - Cold Foam
description:
Sleek. Sculpted. Second-skin.
The NKD Long Sleeve Top is your elevated layering essential, designed to smooth, sculpt and move with you. Featuring a flattering cropped silhouette and fitted design, this long sleeve gym top contours your body with a sleek, second-skin feel that performs as good as it looks.
Crafted from our signature NKD fabric, it's buttery-soft, lightweight and breathable, keeping you comfortable through every workout, stretch and off-duty moment. The streamlined long sleeves add a refined, minimal edge, making it the perfect piece to wear.
Clean. Sculpted. On repeat.
Features
Cropped length for a flattering, on-trend fit
Fitted silhouette to smooth and contour
Long sleeves for added coverage and sleek styling
Signature NKD fabric for ultra-soft, second-skin comfort
Breathable and sweat-wicking
Minimal design for effortless styling
Perfect to pair with NKD leggings or shorts
Signature Ryderwear logo
Fabric: 87% Nylon, 13% Elastane

name: NKD Underwire Bodysuit - Cold Foam
title: NKD Underwire Bodysuit - Cold Foam
description:
Softness meets structure. Sculpted in one step.
The NKD Underwire Bodysuit is where contouring support meets second-skin softness. Designed to shape, lift and define, this all-in-one silhouette combines feminine detailing with built-in structure to enhance your natural curves from every angle.
A ruched front with a subtle keyhole cut-out creates a flattering, sculpted neckline, while the underwire and under-bust band deliver secure, supportive lift. Adjustable crossover straps and a low open back elevate the look, balancing performance with statement styling.
Crafted from our signature NKD fabric, it feels buttery-soft, breathable and smoothing against the skin. Sculpting panels wrap around the body and glutes for a contouring, shapewear-inspired fit, giving you that snatched, confident feel without restriction.
One piece. Fully elevated.
Features
Signature NKD fabric for ultra-soft, second-skin feel
Underwire and under-bust band for structured support
Ruched front with keyhole cut-out for shaping and breathability
Adjustable crossover straps for a customised fit
Low open back for a flattering, elevated look
Sculpting panels designed to contour and enhance your shape
Glute-enhancing design for a lifted, defined look
Regular length short
Removable padding for adjustable coverage
Sweat-wicking and breathable
Signature Ryderwear logo
Fabric: 81% Nylon, 19% Elastane
Model is 167cm tall. She usually wears a size XS and is wearing a size XS. Her waist measures 63cm and her hip measures 102cm.
Recommended for: Training, Pilates, studio sessions and elevated athleisure styling

name: NKD Wide Leggings - Cold Foam
title: NKD Wide Leggings - Cold Foam
description:
Meet your new on and off-duty obsession.
The NKD Wide Leggings are crafted from our signature buttery soft NKD fabric you already know and love, now reimagined in a relaxed, wide-leg silhouette that moves effortlessly from studio to street. Designed to sit smooth and flattering through the waist and hips before falling into a fluid wide leg, this style gives you that “put-together without trying” energy. Lightweight, breathable and second-skin soft, it’s the kind of legging you’ll reach for on repeat…. workouts optional.
Soft enough to lounge. Elevated enough to wear out. We understood the assignment.
Features
Signature NKD fabric for ultra-soft, second-skin comfort
Flattering mid to high-rise waistband that smooths and cinches
Relaxed wide-leg silhouette for effortless movement
Lightweight, breathable and non-restrictive feel
Two lengths available Regular and Tall because fit matters
SIZING: REGULAR = 82cm Inner leg length from gusset to bottom of leg TALL= 87cm Inner leg length from gusset to bottom of leg
Model is 167cm tall. She usually wears a size XS and is wearing a size XS. Her waist measures 63cm and her hip measures 102cm.

Meet your most flattering leggings yet.
The NKD Invisible Scrunch Leggings are designed to sculpt, lift and smooth in all the right places, featuring our innovative invisible scrunch technology for a contoured booty-enhancing fit, without the harsh lines of a traditional scrunch seam.
Crafted from our buttery-soft signature NKD fabric, these full-length leggings deliver a second-skin feel with the perfect amount of stretch and support. The cinching midrise waistband sits comfortably at the waist, while the contoured back enhances your natural curves for a sleek, sculpted silhouette.
Designed with no front seam and an internal leg gusset, they move with you through every squat, stretch and studio session making them your go-to leggings for training, Pilates, yoga and everyday wear.

Booty-enhancing fit without harsh scrunch
Midrise cinching waistband for support and comfort
Contoured back to flatter and enhance your glutes
No front seam for a smooth, no-dig silhouette
Internal leg gusset for unrestricted movement
Full-length design for a flattering, elongating fit
Crafted from buttery-soft signature NKD fabric

The NKD Invisible Scrunch Leggings are designed to sculpt, lift and smooth in all the right places, featuring our innovative invisible scrunch technology for a contoured booty-enhancing fit, without the harsh lines of a traditional scrunch seam.
Crafted from our buttery-soft signature NKD fabric, these full-length leggings deliver a second-skin feel with the perfect amount of stretch and support. The cinching midrise waistband sits comfortably at the waist, while the contoured back enhances your natural curves for a sleek, sculpted silhouette.
Designed with no front seam and an internal leg gusset, they move with you through every squat, stretch and studio session making them your go-to leggings for training, Pilates, yoga and everyday wear.
Features
Innovative invisible scrunch design for a seamless sculpted look
Booty-enhancing fit without harsh scrunch
Midrise cinching waistband for support and comfort
Contoured back to flatter and enhance your glutes
No front seam for a smooth, no-dig silhouette
Internal leg gusset for unrestricted movement
Full-length design for a flattering, elongating fit
Crafted from buttery-soft signature NKD fabric
Fabric: 81% Nylon / 19% Elastane
Recommended for: Training, Pilates, yoga and everyday wear.

The Sculpt Seamless Leggings are engineered to enhance your natural shape while delivering the support you need through every rep. Strong support. Serious shape. Your new glute-day essential.

Full-length seamless gym leggings

Supportive, body-contouring fit

True to size
65cm inner leg seam

name: Aero Luxe Pants - Black
title: Aero Luxe Pants - Black
description:
The pant everyone's about to be obsessed with.
The Aero Lux Pant was designed to bring that effortlessly elevated, off-duty energy to your everyday wardrobe. Inspired by the relaxed tailoring trend taking over active and streetwear right now, this wide leg silhouette combines a lightweight drapey fabric with a sporty elastic waistband for the perfect balance of cool, comfort and polish.
Soft, flowy and ridiculously easy to style, these are the throw-on pants you'll wear from Pilates and coffee runs to airport days, errands and everything in between. The relaxed oversized fit creates that luxe, model-off-duty look, while the lightweight performance fabric keeps the feel breathable, smooth and comfortable all day long.
Pair them with a fitted crop, oversized hoodie or your favourite sports bra for the ultimate cool girl uniform.
Features
Lightweight luxe performance fabric
Relaxed wide leg silhouette
Soft drapey fit for effortless movement
Elastic Ryderwear branded waistband
Side pockets
Full length design
Easy throw-on styling piece
Elevated sporty aesthetic
Designed for lifestyle and everyday wear
Recommended for lifestyle, travel, recovery days and off-duty styling.
Main: 89% Polyester, 11% Elastane

name: NKD Wide Leg Leggings - Sky Blue
title: NKD Wide Leg Leggings - Sky Blue
typePath: NKD Wide Leg Leggings - Sky Blue
description:
Meet your new on and off-duty obsession.
The NKD Wide Leggings are crafted from our signature buttery soft NKD fabric you already know and love, now reimagined in a relaxed, wide-leg silhouette that moves effortlessly from studio to street. Designed to sit smooth and flattering through the waist and hips before falling into a fluid wide leg, this style gives you that “put-together without trying” energy. Lightweight, breathable and second-skin soft, it’s the kind of legging you’ll reach for on repeat…. workouts optional.
Soft enough to lounge. Elevated enough to wear out. We understood the assignment.
Features
Signature NKD fabric for ultra-soft, second-skin comfort
Flattering mid to high-rise waistband that smooths and cinches
Relaxed wide-leg silhouette for effortless movement
Lightweight, breathable and non-restrictive feel
Two lengths available Regular and Tall because fit matters
SIZING: REGULAR = 82cm Inner leg length from gusset to bottom of leg    TALL= 87cm Inner leg length from gusset to bottom of leg
Model wears size S and is 170cm/5'7" tall.

description:

Rubberised resistance band

THIS BAND BELONGS IN YOUR GYM BAG
 Resistance bands are lightweight, affordable and can be used to help you keep up your fitness while you’re on the go, all while providing a challenging full body workout. From legs to your lats, resistance bands can tone and strengthen your entire body, while tending to offer less impact on your muscles and joints, helping you show your body a little more love. A resistance band can also be used to make difficult exercises like pull ups more accessible & easier by supporting your weight, while also being great for stretching and releasing any muscular tension.

You are in charge. You are in control. You don't need anybody but yourself. Set your own rules and go rogue in Ryderwear's latest D-Mak lifting shoe.
The D-Mak Rogue is the ultimate hardcore lifting shoe, created for heavy, bar-bending lifts. The thin, flat rubber sole offers a barefoot feel while still providing maximum grip and stability, while the classic high top design gives you unrivaled stability and ankle support.
These lightweight lifting shoes are the bodybuilders footwear of choice, made to give you the confidence to push your limits and smash your PB's. Join the serious lifter's club with a pair of D-Mak Rogues.
-Action Leather & Polyester
-Customised Ryderwear flat sole
-Quilt textured body
-Quality action and suede leather
-Custom triangle eyelets
-Padded interior for support and stability
-Perfect for bodybuilding and powerlifting
**These are a men's style shoe and are in men's U.S. sizes. Please refer to the size chart to determine your size.**
UPPER: 50% Leather/50% Polyester. LINING: 100% Textile. SOLE: 100% Synthetic.
The sizing of these shoes are listed in US Mens size.

Flat Sole

name: D-Mak Carbon Fibre - Black
title: D-Mak Carbon Fibre - Black
description:
Strong. Stealthy. Lightweight.
Take your training to the next level with the D-Mak Carbon Fibre by Ryderwear. The D-Mak is the ultimate hardcore lifting shoe, offering a flat, thin sole for unparalleled support and correct lifting form. With the functionality of our original lifting shoes fused with a futuristic design, this is the pro bodybuilders shoe of choice, boasting modern tech patterned fabrics and carbon fibre detailed vinyl panels. With a high top design, these men’s lifting shoes offer essential support on leg day, while allowing you to get closer to the ground for maximum power and drive in your lifts.
-Premium Action Leather
-Padded Ankle Support
-Thin Flat Sole
-Latex Heel Cushioning
-High-top Profile
-Perfect for bodybuilding
-Rubber traction sole for grip
Recommended for gym training, bodybuilding and weight lifting.
These are a men's style shoe and are in mens U.S. sizes. Please refer to the size chart to determine your size.
UPPER: 40% Leather, 30% Polyester and 30% Polyurethane. LINING: 100% Polyester. SOLE: Rubber.
Here's what our community are saying about this product
 ‘I was skeptical at first as to how much difference these would make to your performance, but after wearing them for a number of workouts I’m absolutely in love with them. Fantastic quality, comfort and support. I feel so much more stable and powerful when wearing them. I would recommend these to anyone who lifts and wants to level up their training!’ 
‘I’m so happy with this purchase. Just like other shoes that I’ve purchased from Ryderwear, they come out of the box, ready to use straight away. No breaking in required. They fit comfortably and are true to size!’ 
‘Just as amazing as I was hoping. The foot measurements are really accurate and gave me the perfect fit. It feels like I’m walking around barefoot in the gym, they’re just so comfortable. I’m going to buy another pair for every day, very soon!’
The sizing of these shoes are listed in US Mens size.

name: Ryderwear Face Mask - Black
title: Ryderwear Face Mask - Black
description:
A washable, reusable face mask made for you to practice healthy habits every day. This is a non-medical mask to use as an additional measure to keep yourself and others safe while reserving medical grade masks for front line workers. Whilst wearing you should still continue to practise social distancing. 
Layer 1 (outer): 4-way stretch microfiber nylon 
Layer 2 (inner): 100% OEKO-TEX certified cotton 
3mm comfort elastic ear band with a toggle 
Flexible nose wire 
Washable and reusable 
One size fits all 
This mask is not intended for medical use.
MASK ON
 Mask up before you muscle up, the new normal is here to stay. A well-ventilated, microfibre mask can help you train hard and breathe easy, along with a few helpful tips. Adapt to training with a face mask by placing extra focus on your breathing during your lifting workout. Make sure you focus on taking deeper, slower inhales through your nose, as well as slowing down your exhales. This will keep you from becoming too lightheaded or overly anxious about your breathing, while maximising oxygen delivery to your lungs, to benefit your lifting performance.

name: D-Mak Originals - Black
title: D-Mak Originals - Black
description:
Original design, next-level performance. The ideal shoe to start your bodybuilding journey, The D-Mak Originals are the ultimate hardcore lifting kicks, with the our iconic flat rubber sole for unparalleled support and correct form. This is the pro bodybuilders shoe of choice, with suede and canvas fabrics designed to outlast a lifetime of heavy lifts. With a high-top design and padded ankle support, these shoes offer essential support on leg day, allowing you to get closer to the ground for maximum power and drive in your lifts. 
Premium Action Leather 
Padded Ankle Support 
High-top Profile
Latex Heel Cushioning 
Thin Flat Sole
Rubber traction sole for grip
**These are a men's style shoe and are in men's U.S. sizes. Please refer to the size chart to determine your size.**
Recommended for gym training, bodybuilding and weightlifting.
WHY YOU NEED LIFTING SHOES IN YOUR LOCKER 
You’re a hardcore lifter, with a relentless passion for taking your physique to the next level. The number of plates stacked on the bar is meaningful to you, and you’re continually trying to push your limits, always searching for that edge. You want to be renowned and respected for your physique, and for the enormity of your lifts. You like the sound of iron clashing against iron, and how the ground tremors after you finish a heavy set. You want a shoe engineered to maximise your power on leg day, with all of the benefits of barefoot lifting, but the added element of traction and stability that a lifting shoe offers. If you’ve ever sacrificed sleep ins for squats, tracked your macros meticulously or spilt blood and scraped away skin in pursuit of a PB, then a lifting shoe belongs in your locker.
Upper: 50% Suede Leather/50% Polyester. Lining: 100% Textile. Sole: 100% Synthetic.
The sizing of these shoes are listed in US Mens size.

name: D-Mak Evo - Black
title: D-Mak Evo - Black
description:
The latest evolution of our iconic, game-changing lifting shoe. The D-Mak Evo is the ultimate workout footwear for the modern lifter, created for bar-bending, earth-shaking lifts. The thin, flatter rubber sole offers that barefoot feel while still providing maximum grip, taking your power and drive to the next level. The premium suede exterior is designed to outlast a lifetime of heavy lifts, while the new padded ankle exterior offers extra ankle stability while you push your limits and conquer PBs. 
Padded Interior for support and stability
Quality Suede Leather 
Customised Ryderwear Flat Sole
Perfect for bodybuilding and powerlifting
**These are a men's style shoe and are in men's U.S. sizes. Please refer to the size chart to determine your size.**
WHY YOU NEED LIFTING SHOES IN YOUR LOCKER
 Lifting shoes are made for lifting, which means they’ll have you covered for years of heavy workouts & sweat sessions. While wearing everyday shoes in the squat rack ensures they’ll quickly be destined for the scrapheap, a pair of weightlifting shoes is for life. They might set you back slightly more than your average sneaker but it’s a worthwhile investment, as they should last for a minimum of ten years of lifting, training and squatting. This is all down to the premium, high-quality fabrics used, with the Ryderwear D-Mak created from near-indestructible materials, like a durable canvas, action and suede leather as well as a latex heel cushioning. This all contributes to the longevity of the lifting shoe lifecycle!
Upper: 100% Suede Leather. Lining: 100% Polyester. Sole: 100% Polyester.
